name: Masanobu
source:
A little boy who is Koga's friend.
[spoiler]His older brother was Koga's childhood friend, but Koga lost his mind due to his "carnage" illness one day and accidentally killed Masanobu's brother. Since then, Koga has felt terrible about it and tries to atone by caring for Masanobu.[/spoiler]
